title: Call Log Delete-Backup Restore
description:
Call Log Recovery App: Manage and Restore Your History!

Take control of your history with the ultimate Call History Recovery App. Designed to help you delete, backup, and restore logs effortlessly, this app gives you complete control over your phone logs. It provides a reliable solution for restoring deleted histories. Whether you’re looking to recover a specific log or manage your entire history, the Call Log Recovery App offers the perfect blend of convenience and functionality. Call Log: Delete, Backup, Restore Key Features: ☑️ Effortless Call Log: Delete, Backup, Restore; ☑️ Call Log Recovery App: Backup And Restore; ☑️ Log Details Management; ☑️ Phone Call Logs Backup; ☑️ Call History Manager; ☑️ ID and Spam Blocker; ☑️ Flexible Options for Log Management; ☑️ Multi-delete for Multiple Logs; ☑️ Manual or Auto Delete Log; ☑️ Recovery and Restore Features!

Efficient Log Management Made Easy!

The Call Log Recovery App is designed to make managing your history a breeze. With features like Call Log: Delete, Backup, Restore, you can easily select any log you want to delete and remove it with a single tap. For those who need a quick cleanup, the Call History Recovery App offers an auto-delete feature that can remove selected logs, freeing up space on your device and simplifying your history management. Call Log Recovery and Backup: Never Lose Important Logs: This Call Log Recovery App: Backup And Restore feature ensures your history is safe. Create backups of your phone logs and store them securely so you can restore them whenever needed. With just a few taps, the Call Log Recovery App lets you keep a backup of every dial, making it easy to restore any lost or deleted log. This is essential for maintaining a secure call history record for future reference. Detailed Call Log History Recovery: Quickly access detailed log information with the Call Log Details feature. The app organizes all histories in an accessible format, allowing you to see every detail of your phone logs. This Call History Recovery App is invaluable for tracking specific Call Log Details or organizing your history for easier reference. Use our Call Log: Delete, Backup, Restore app with ease. Phone Call Logs Backup and Restore: Take full advantage of the Phone Call Logs Backup feature to keep your data safe. This Call History Manager provides secure backup options, ensuring that your data remains intact even if deleted by mistake. Intuitive and Powerful Call Log Details Tool Our Call History Manager makes organizing and accessing all your records easy. You can keep your log organized and clutter-free with options to backup and restore histories. This app allows you to delete logs as needed and manage, backup, and restore them with minimal effort. Why We Request Certain PermissionsREAD_CALL_LOG: Allows the app to read your call history so you can view, backup, and recover deleted call logs. WRITE_CALL_LOG: Enables the app to restore and manage call history by writing logs back to your device. READ_SMS: Used for potential future features involving SMS log recovery (if applicable). Ensures log context completeness. android.permission.WRITE_SMS: Required for restoring deleted SMS messages in supported versions (if SMS support is integrated). PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS: Used to identify outgoing calls in real-time for automatic log updates and accurate backup. ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS: Lets the app automate call handling when blocking is enabled or for call-based triggers. READ_PHONE_STATE: Needed to detect incoming or ongoing calls, helping the app avoid conflicts during operations such as deletion or recovery./i>

title: Empire City: Build and Conquer
description:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to run an entire Empire?
Now with Empire City: Build and Conquer you will be able to:
Build new beautiful cities, develop resource extraction,make your own unique culture, trade with other civilizations and make fantastic discoveries that will help you in the future.You have a chance to bring it all to life and become a real emperor with Empire City! 

Ancient civilizations and their advanced construction technologies will be available to you. It will look like a real rise of empires and civilizations. Create the most unusual buildings and structures that descendants will call “Wonders of the Ancient World”. Dig canals to help your farmers, create intricate and bizarre viaducts, erect epic statues of Gods and Heroes!

You can develop not only construction, but also contact the world.Age of empires is here, make your own one! Become the most powerful kingdom in the world.
Build trade relations, diplomacy, exchange knowledge and technology with others. Become the center of the trade routes.

Expand your influence and territory. Join new lands and develop them, get even more useful resources and gain the respect of your subjects. Be a peaceful leader or a domineering tyrant - the choice is yours.
After all, the main thing is to go down in history and create the most powerful ancient city-empire!

Be the first in everything, be the best at all stages of your city's development.
Only you influence your future, only you decide what your empire will be like!

Features of the game:

- Unique development options
Choose your own way to rise your empire.
- Construction of the most unusual ancient buildings
Build your own powerful kingdom.
- Fantastic atmosphere of the ancient world
Get inspired by the beautiful views of your empire.
- Impressive scope
Feel the greatness of your new kingdom.
- Freedom of any actions and choices
Build your kingdom as you can see it.
- Amazing graphics and addictive gameplay
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the ancient world.

title: AoC - Medieval Simulator
description:
Lead a great empire, command an army, lead people into battle, and win on the battlefield. Build an economy that will rival the strongest nations, engage in diplomatic games, and become an active player on the international stage. Fight as the greatest civilization in world history!

Age of Colonization is the best strategy for governing a state, army, and politics. Your battlefield will be the year 1600, and you will face the mightiest empires of Europe, Asia, and African countries.

Choose any of more than 40 nations and embark on exciting battles, creating your own new timeline. Each civilization, from the Holy Roman Empire to Japan, from the Great Chinese Min Empire to England, will be your opponent and possesses its own ambitions and strong will. Create your army and test your luck against other nations, showcase your historical might in battles, establish alliances, and sign treaties to conquer the entire world.

Build your empire from the Pacific Ocean to the Atlantic, embark on a historical conquest journey right now!

In the game, you can expect:

▪️ Real-time strategy, even works offline
▪️ Colonization of new lands with endless possibilities and resources
▪️ Challenging opponents with powerful armies and their allies
▪️ Conquest of new territories, plundering defeated enemies
▪️ Historical countries and empires, deep immersion in the era
▪️ Trade with other countries for economic growth
▪️ A multitude of exciting research to improve your army, diplomacy, economy, and colonization
▪️ Cunning and challenging tasks with unique bonuses
▪️ Pirates, bandits, saboteurs, spies, epidemics, pandemics, rebellions, and many other challenges

Build the greatest civilization in history, develop battle strategies and tactics to defeat your enemies. Join millions of players around the world and achieve global dominance in the Age of Colonization!

Download the game now and start building your great civilization!

The game is localized in the following languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Polish, German, Arabic, Italian, Japanese, Indonesian.

👉 Have questions or issues with the game? Write to us at info@oxiwyle.com.

✅ Join the community on Discord to be the first to learn about all the news and updates: https://discord.com/invite/bNzwYDNstc

title: Idle Museum Tycoon: Art Empire
description: The goal of this fun tycoon game is to construct, repair, and manage an entire Museum. Art, Culture, and History is your business! You need to administer exhibitions of all kinds to attract visitors to see and contemplate the most incredible art and history collections of all time! Manage and optimize resources like a business management simulator game and build now your art empire! Start with a small gallery, get visitors into the Museum, sell tickets to earn money, invest your earnings to buy new sets of cool art collections, and build more themed galleries! You will be in charge of building, repairing, and leading installations from contemporary art, pop art, modern art and classic art, where you will show paintings and sculptures made by famous artists and the greatest minds! How about showing the best Leonardo da Vinci works in your renaissance gallery? It’s not only about art, the Museum is also about history and science! Bring to your Jurassic exhibition the greatest dinosaur findings, like a triceratops fossil or the mighty tyrannosaurus rex! You may want to build a gallery to show relics from Egypt, Greece or China, artifacts from ancient civilizations like the Aztecs and Mayans, and show off all kinds of historical pieces from around the world. How about traveling to outer space? Your guests can while visiting the Space gallery, presenting the greatest achievements in astronomy! Beyond space probes, rockets, satellites, space suits, space crafts, and all other flight technology made by humanity, the visitors can also learn about planets, stars and galaxies! This Museum can be huge with your help and the visitors can also explore the ocean world! Yes, you can manage exhibitions of the wonders of the seas. Sharks, whales, prehistoric fishes and underwater monsters! As a supervisor, it is your job to take care of all the big and small tasks to keep the business running and the profits coming! To help with that, this idle game also offers a cool Trivia game with lots of cultural quizzes to play! Test your knowledge on different topics like Art, History, Culture, Middle Age, Ancient Civilizations, Music, Science, and get prizes to help you improve the Museum. Enjoy this tycoon game and renovate a Museum to become the richest businessman in town! Features: - Easy to play and hard to master. - Upgrade your exhibitions by collecting more stuff for the gallery! - Win prizes by answering cool trivia games! - Manage resources to maximize money income and build new attractions! - Hire tour guides and managers to improve your profits. - Tons of exhibits to manage: Renaissance, Jurassic, Contemporary art, Egypt, Space, Mesoamerica, Greek and Roman art, Medieval, Asia, Modern art, Africa, Pop art, Nordic history, and much more to come like musical instruments, exhibitions of cars and airplanes! - Collect rare artifacts and expensive relics! - Real-time 3D graphics! Expand your Museum and become the richest art tycoon of all time! Have a problem? Want to suggest a cool new feature? Send your feedback to Pixodust Games. We love to hear from our players! support@pixodust.com Be sure to check for updates. We're always working on ways of improving gameplay and adding new features! Privacy Policy: https://pixodust.com/games_privacy_policy/ Terms and Conditions: https://pixodust.com/terms-and-conditions/

title: Europe 1784 Military strategy
description:
Welcome to the world of global changes and new opportunities, where you will become a wise ruler and lead your nation in pursuit of victory in the captivating geopolitical strategy game Europe 1784. This is your unique chance to create your own version of history, where the Russian Empire and France, the Maratha Empire and the Qing Empire, Japan and Choson, the Holy Roman Empire and the Ottoman Empire will clash. Europe, North Africa, and Asia lay before you as uncharted territories for conquest, truce, trade, and exploration. Choose the country you will govern and challenge kings and emperors!

Diplomacy and cunning political maneuvering are the keys to success. Make non-aggression pacts with your neighbors, form powerful alliances, and participate in votes on critical matters on the world stage. But be vigilant, as war always looms, and you must be prepared to defend your nation when the situation demands it.

But diplomacy is not the only facet of your rule. You'll also manage your nation's economy. Produce food, military equipment, weapons, and other resources necessary to sustain your armed forces and the economy of your country. Build structures, conduct research to enhance your technological prowess, and make your nation invincible.

The game Europe 1784 offers you a unique opportunity to rewrite history. Your diplomatic and strategic decisions will shape the future of your nation. The possibilities are endless, and, as a true leader, your mission is to elevate your nation to greatness.

Game Features:

❆ An Army of the Great Conqueror ❆

Build an unparalleled army: musketeers, grenadiers, dragoons, cuirassiers, cannons, and warships. Enact military laws, strengthen mobilization, and military production. Train and hone your army's experience in battles and explore the art of war. War is the domain of the strong and the brave

❆ Colonization of New Lands ❆

The vast territories of North Africa and the Arabian Peninsula are open for colonization and exploration. Colonies will help expand your empire, increase your population, boost your economy, and lead to unprecedented greatness. Bring the light of civilization and technology to new lands

❆ International Roundtable ❆

Participate in votes at Assemblies, explore the nuances of diplomacy and international relations, take part in shaping the fate of the world, seek loyal allies and friends, and form alliances to repel enemy attacks

❆ Wealth and Prosperity ❆

Develop your nation's economy: collect tributes, trade goods, and pursue research for economic growth. Implement economic laws, flourish exports and imports, and increase civilian production. The well-being of your people is in your hands.

❆ Cultural Supremacy ❆

Spread your religion, organize feasts, carnivals, fairs, theatrical performances, worship services, and tournaments. This is your chance to become the most beloved ruler in history. Bread and entertainment for the people!

The gameplay will captivate you for hours, allowing you to showcase your diplomatic, economic, and military strategy skills. The game can be played offline, giving you the freedom to play anytime, anywhere.

Download Europe 1784 now and embark on your path to greatness. Your nation awaits a strong and wise leader. Leave your mark on history!

The game is localized in the following languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian, Portuguese, French, Chinese, Russian, Turkish, Polish, German, Arabic, Italian, Japanese, Indonesian.

👉 Do you have questions or encounter issues with the game? Email us at info@oxiwyle.com.

✅ Join our Discord community to stay informed about all the latest news and updates first: https://discord.com/invite/bNzwYDNstc

title: History Master: Study & Quiz
description:
Study world history the way your brain actually works, with timelines you can scroll, mind maps for every era, and flashcards for fast revision. History Master 2.3 is a complete redesign of the app trusted by students from middle school to college.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Interactive timeline from prehistory to today. Tap any event for instant context.
• Mind maps for ancient civilizations, the Middle Ages, the modern world, and contemporary history.
• Flashcards with quiz mode for fast, focused revision.
• Build your own study material: make your own mind maps and flashcard decks.
• Brand-new visual design across every screen.

PERFECT FOR
• Middle and high school students preparing for class tests.
• College students looking for a clear, structured history reference.
• Anyone curious about how the world actually got here.

COVERAGE
Prehistory, ancient civilizations (Egypt, Greece, Rome, China, India), Middle Ages, Renaissance and early modern, Enlightenment, 19th century, the World Wars, Cold War, and contemporary events. Updated and expanded for 2.3.

PREMIUM
The app is free to try. Premium unlocks all content, all mind maps, all flashcard decks, and lets you build unlimited personal study material.

TERMS OF USE & SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
History Master offers an optional auto-renewing subscription ("Premium"), available as a monthly or yearly plan.
• Payment is processed through Google Play Billing at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions at any time from your Google Play account settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

History Master offers an optional auto-renewing subscription ("Premium"), available as a monthly or yearly plan.
• Payment is processed through Google Play Billing at confirmation of purchase.
• Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• You can manage and cancel subscriptions at any time from your Google Play account settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

title: HealthDiary: Medical History
description:
HealthDiary: Medical History – All-in-One Health Records & Tracker App

Take control of your health with HealthDiary: Medical History, the ultimate app to store, track, and manage your complete personal health record in one secure place. From doctor visit logs to vital signs tracking, this app simplifies your healthcare journey and helps you stay organized, informed, and proactive.

🔍 Key Features:
✅ Centralized Medical Record Storage
Securely store your health history, including doctor visits, diagnoses, medications, family medical history, allergies, lab test results, and more. All your critical health data in one place.

✅ Track Vital Signs Easily
Log and monitor blood pressure, blood glucose, oxygen saturation (SpO2), and other vitals with beautiful, interactive health charts. Ideal for those managing chronic conditions like diabetes or hypertension.

✅ Appointment Reminders & Doctor Visit Logs
Never miss a checkup! Set smart reminders for appointments, medications, and vaccinations. Easily manage multiple clinics, hospitals, or healthcare providers.

✅ Generate PDF & Excel Health Reports
Quickly export and share health reports in PDF or Excel (XLS) format with your doctor or caregiver. Ideal for health checkups, second opinions, and emergencies.

✅ Attach Photos, Scans & Lab Reports
Add multimedia attachments like prescription images, X-rays, lab results, or notes to any health entry for a complete record.

✅ Visualize Health Trends
Gain insights with easy-to-understand graphs of your blood sugar, BP, and oxygen levels. Spot patterns, improvements, or concerns over time.

✅ Google Drive Backup & Sync
Your medical history stays safe with automatic cloud backup to Google Drive. Access your health data across multiple devices anytime, anywhere.

✅ Multiple Profiles & Easy Switching
Manage health records for your entire family or multiple individuals using separate profiles within the same app.

Whether you're managing a chronic condition, caring for a loved one, or simply want to keep your health data organized and accessible, HealthDiary: Medical History is the must-have digital health companion in 2025.

🔒 100% Secure & Private | 🏥 Doctor-Friendly Format | 📊 Designed for Everyday Health Monitoring

title: TikStory - Learn History
description:
From ancient empires to pivotal world events, TikStory – History in Bites transforms the way you explore the past. No textbooks. No timelines. Just quick, scrollable cards packed with fascinating historical facts, striking visuals, and key dates—all curated to spark your curiosity in seconds.

Why TikStory?
Because history shouldn’t feel like homework. Whether you're killing time in line, commuting, or winding down at night, TikStory gives you fast, fascinating glimpses into the moments that shaped our world.

Impress friends with unexpected facts at dinner.

Brush up on your history knowledge before that quiz or pub trivia night.

Explore turning points that explain today’s world—from ancient power struggles to modern revolutions.

Rediscover the wonder of human achievement, art, invention, and resilience.

Each card is a micro-story, designed to teach, surprise, and delight—without ever feeling overwhelming.

What You’ll Explore in TikStory
📖 Historical Facts
Quick-hit insights you didn’t learn in school. From Cleopatra’s political genius to Cold War quirks—every card gives you something to think (or talk) about.

🖼️ Iconic Images
Zoom into history’s most powerful visuals—photographs, paintings, statues, manuscripts. See the Codex Aureus in shimmering detail or explore a Roman mosaic like never before.

📅 Key Dates That Changed the World
What happened in 1492? Or 1914? We don’t just give you the date—we give you context, so you understand why it matters.

Features to Love
📚 Endless Discovery
With over 500 unique cards (and growing weekly), you’ll never run out of things to explore. Whether you're into Ancient Rome or the Space Age, there's always something new.

🗂️ Bookmark Favorites
See something fascinating? Save it with a tap and revisit your personal collection of insights anytime.

🎯 Tailor Your Feed
Customize what you see. Prefer Medieval Europe over Ancient China? Choose your preferred historical periods and get a feed that reflects your interests.

🌍 Learn Without Pressure
No tests, no chapters, no commitment. Just pure curiosity, satisfied one card at a time.

📱 Designed for Modern Minds
Fast-loading, easy to scroll, and beautifully minimal. TikStory feels like your favorite social feed—but way more enriching.

Whether you’re a lifelong history lover or just curious about the past, TikStory makes learning feel effortless. Every moment is a chance to discover something new—while waiting for your coffee, on the train, or just killing five minutes before bed.

Start scrolling, start learning, and start seeing the world through the lens of history.

TikStory – History in Bites.
The past, reimagined for your pocket.
